map.📝 Farnsworth D-15 色相排列测试：拖拽排序 · 色相轨迹图 ·: 📝 Farnsworth D-15 Hue Arrangement Test: Drag to Order · Hue Trajectory · Auto Typing
map.经典 Farnsworth Panel D-15 色相排列测试的浏览器实现。15: A browser implementation of the classic Farnsworth Panel D-15 hue arrangement test. The 15 caps are converted in real time from the standard D-15 CIE 1931 xy chromaticity coordinates at constant luminance (Munsell value 5, Y≈19.8%) into displayable sRGB values; the two end reference caps are fixed, and the middle 13 caps must be ordered by the continuous hue gradient. After submission, the program projects the 15 caps onto the CIE 1976 u′v′ polar system, draws a hue-trajectory chart by connecting them in your order, then does a moment-of-inertia axial analysis on the "cross-jump vectors" and compares the principal-axis direction against the red/green/blue dichromatic confusion lines to give a color-vision typing and severity reading. All computation runs locally; no data is uploaded.
map.取 D-15 的 15 个色度点 (x, y)，在固定亮度 Y 下换算 XYZ: Take D-15's 15 chromaticity points (x, y), convert at fixed luminance Y to XYZ = (Y/y·x, Y, Y/y·(1−x−y)), then through the sRGB inverse matrix to linear RGB; out-of-gamut points are compressed into the gamut by binary search along the "converge to same-luminance neutral gray" direction, so the 15 caps

map.。S 越大说明错误越集中在一条直线上（二色视特征），S≈1 说明错误是随机的。: . A larger S means errors are concentrated along one line (dichromat trait); S≈1 means errors are random.
The three confusion lines are determined by the dichromatic copunctal points—protanopia (0.747, 0.253), deuteranopia (1.400, −0.400), tritanopia (0.171, 0.000). Connecting them with the D65 white point and projecting to u′v′ gives three reference axial angles; θ is assigned to whichever is closest, and severity is graded by the size of C.

map.正常排列呈连续色相环；若出现沿红-绿轴的跨位连线（如把红与绿相邻误排），提示红绿: A normal arrangement forms a continuous hue circle; if a cross-position line appears along the red-green axis (e.g. placing red and green adjacent by mistake), it suggests red-green (protan/deutan) deficiency; a cross-position along the blue-yellow axis suggests blue-yellow (tritan) deficiency; more errors means higher severity.

map.tritan（蓝黄）类型本身较少见，若出现蓝黄轴跨位连线应特别注意，必要时进一步: The tritan (blue-yellow) type itself is rarer; if a blue-yellow cross-position line appears, pay special attention and assess further if needed.
